subject: Pilot charter & deployment pathway selection — next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot charter & deployment pathway selection — next steps

Hi Emma / Raj —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — good cadence and very helpful context. I wanted to capture the facts & proposed next steps so we can land the pilot approach quickly. High-level summary from our call: 

- Primary constraint: Medlytics needs PHI-safe handling and encryption; security prefers Private VPC but is open to staged approaches if we can show controls.
- Volume/latency profile: ~250 reqs/min peak for inference, 99th-percentile latency target ~300ms, batch-friendly but some interactive latency spikes.
- Evaluation goals: validate model accuracy on our clinical prompt set, measure 95th/99th latency at expected load, and validate ingestion + key management.

Options we discussed (brief):
1) Hosted API (fastest): Redwood-hosted, tenant isolation, streaming + strict retention; fastest time-to-value but requires evaluating encryption/KMS integration and DPA amendments.
2) Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool for predictable throughput and additional isolation; good middle ground for cost/perf.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem): meets strict security reqs but adds lead time for network setup and onboarding.

Proposed pilot approach (recommended): a staged pilot (4–6 weeks total):
- Week 0: legal/compliance & kickoff (MSA/Eval Addendum signed), schedule technical workshop.
- Week 1–2: Hosted isolated tenancy + KMS integration to validate model selection and baseline latency/cost.
- Week 3–4: Move to Dedicated capacity if performance/cost trade-offs need to be tested; optionally prototype VPC network prep in parallel.

Initial success criteria (examples we can firm up in the charter):
- Functional: baseline accuracy on labeled clinical prompts within X% of your target (we'll import your gold set).
- Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms at target QPS for the chosen configuration.
- Security: KMS integration + DPA signed; data retention policy validated in console.

Next steps I propose:
- I will share a pilot charter and proposed schedule (attached).
- SE (Prioyam) to run a technical workshop next week to validate infra assumptions & gather keys.
- Aditya will share an illustrative pricing estimate for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.

Are you available for a 60-min technical workshop on Wed Apr 7 or Thu Apr 8?

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your constraints.

Regards,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Lauren — good write-up. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Security posture: our InfoSec lead (Raj) has already stated that production will need Private VPC or equivalent (customer-managed network) for any production PHI workloads. That said, for an initial evaluation we can consider a locked-down Hosted tenancy if KMS and DPA are in place and data never persists past processing windows.

2) Timeline: we are aiming to have a validated pilot outcome before the end of Q2 (ideally June 30). If we need long lead times for Private VPC, we need to know that up-front.

3) Budget: our procurement team has constrained the pilot to a $XXk budget range unless there's clear ROI for an expanded scope. Please include cost anchors.

We can do the technical workshop on Thu Apr 8 (10:00–11:00 PT) — Raj will join for the security deep dive. Please confirm and share the workshop agenda.

—Emma

Lauren / team — quick internal note before we lock schedules: 

- I agree with staging the pilot. For commercial positioning with Medlytics, propose we offer three lanes in the estimate: 
  a) Hosted (isolated tenancy + KMS) — lowest lead time, lower setup cost, faster validation.
  b) Dedicated reserved GPUs — higher monthly commit, predictable throughput; good for production if they want SLAs.
  c) Private VPC (customer-managed network) — highest setup time and cost but meets strict PHI requirements.

- Pricing anchors (very rough for workshop discussion): Hosted pilot execution ~$8–12k for 4 weeks (model compute + infra), Dedicated evaluation (4 weeks w/reserve) ~$25–40k depending on GPU type & commit, Private VPC setup (one-time onboarding) ~$40–70k + monthly infra. We'll refine after SE sizing.

Action items: Prioyam — can you produce a draft pilot charter and explicit success metrics + a short checklist for network/VPC requirements? Vanessa — can you prep a short procurement checklist & lead time expectations we can share? I'll own the initial estimate and commercial framing.

I'll plan to present the three-lane estimate in the workshop on Apr 8.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Draft pilot charter + success metrics (attached)

Folks — attached is a one-page pilot charter draft and a short tech checklist (see attachments). Key items are below; I kept the language prescriptive so the customer can sign off quickly.

Pilot charter (summary):
- Scope: Evaluate model accuracy on Medlytics clinical prompt set (imported gold labels), measure latency under 250–300ms 95th percentile at target QPS, validate KMS integration and data retention policy for PHI.
- Duration: 4 weeks (option to extend 2 weeks if we need dedicated testing).
- Environments: Stage 1 = Hosted isolated tenancy + KMS; Stage 2 = Dedicated capacity (optional); Stage 3 = Private VPC onboarding (parallel network prep).
- Deliverables: weekly test reports, a final evaluation runbook, performance dashboard, and a short runbook for cutover recommendations.

Suggested success criteria (examples to finalize with Medlytics):
- Accuracy: F1 or appropriate metric within agreed threshold on gold prompt set.
- Latency: 95th < 300ms; tail behavior documented at 99th.
- Throughput: sustain target QPS with <5% error rate under simulated traffic.
- Security: KMS keys integrated, DPA signed, network ingress validated for Private VPC.

Network/VPC checklist (short):
- Customer VPN or AWS Direct Connect details (ASN, IP ranges)
- Firewall allowlist (Redwood Egress IPs)
- KMS access and key rotation policy
- Audit log forwarding (where required)

Attachments referenced: redwood_pilot_charter_v1.pdf, pricing_estimate_dedicated_vs_private.xlsx, redwood_compliance_packet.zip

On the SOC2/DPA front: linking our summary here — https://redwood.com/docs/soc2-summary — and I noted a compressed compliance packet (attached) for legal review.

I'll be at the technical workshop Thu Apr 8 10:00 PT; planned agenda: 1) security checklist & KMS questions (15m) 2) traffic profile & sample prompts (20m) 3) pilot timeline & deliverables (15m) 4) next steps & ticketing (10m).

Cheers,
Prioyam Das
